# gravitino_model Resource

Manages a Gravitino model within a metalake, catalog, and schema.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "gravitino_model" "example" {
  # ... example configuration ...
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) The catalog name.
- `metalake` (String) The metalake name.
- `name` (String) The model name.
- `schema` (String) The schema name.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) A comment describing the model.
- `model_uri` (String) The URI of the model artifact.
- `properties` (Map of String) Key-value properties for the model.

### Read-Only

- `audit` (Object) Audit information for the model. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audit))
- `id` (String) The compound identifier in the format metalake.catalog.schema.model.

<a id="nestedatt--audit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `audit`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String)
- `creator` (String)
- `last_modified_time` (String)
- `last_modifier` (String)
